name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2026-07-02, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.14 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
